description: Three Windows Media Audio version 1 files that Microsoft's own encoder wrote (the codec list names "Microsoft Audio Codec", format tag 0x0160, with Microsoft MPEG-4 Video V3), from the FFmpeg sample archive (samples.ffmpeg.org, A-codecs/WMA1). Commercial content: none is committed or uploaded anywhere public; scripts/fixtures/wma1_microsoft_samples.py downloads them at their SHA-256, from the archive first and then from the private repository (mirrors/samples/ffmpeg-wma1). They are the reference of the version 1 decoder against Microsoft's decoder, which the Windows run (windows-wma-decode.yml) writes the samples of; none uses variable block lengths.

ffmpeg.terms: The FFmpeg sample archive's 00-README: "You are free to download any samples you want". They are downloaded and checked, not committed.

samples.audio: 16 kHz mono, 16 kbit/s, line spectral pair exponents
44.1 kHz stereo, 64 kbit/s, scale factor exponents, cut short
22 kHz stereo, 32 kbit/s, audio spread over packets (asf.audio-spread)
